title: Deprecating Spark 3.4
summary: Kevin Liu proposed marking Spark 3.4, which had reached end of life upstream, as deprecated in Iceberg 1.11 and removing it in 1.12. The proposal drew many +1s. Anton Okolnychyi and Eduard Tudenhöfner questioned the deprecate-then-remove-a-release-later rule and favoured removing it sooner, because old Spark modules slow down format work; Parth Chandra and Huaxin Gao asked to keep 3.4 longer because Comet still supports it. The docs status was changed to Deprecated in October 2025 (PR #14099). In January 2026 Kevin proposed releasing 1.11 with Spark 3.4, with no obligation to backport everything, and removing the module right after. In May 2026 he reported that the removal PR (#14122) was merged and that 1.11.0 is the last Iceberg version supporting Spark 3.4. Manu Zhang noted fixes may still ship on the 1.11.x branch.

positions.stance: Mark Spark 3.4 deprecated in 1.11 and remove it in 1.12, as it is end-of-life upstream.
Questions keeping the deprecate-then-remove model, since older Spark modules lag in features and have become a liability that slows format work such as row IDs.
Remove Spark 3.4 in the next release; users who need it can stay on Iceberg 1.10.
Making Hadoop 3.4.1 the base version already makes Iceberg partly incompatible with Spark 3.4, as shown by classpath failures in a PR using BulkDelete.
Asked for one more Iceberg release with Spark 3.4 so Comet users on 3.4 do not have to build their own.
Keep Spark 3.4 for a couple more versions instead of removing it in 1.11.
Release 1.11 with Spark 3.4 without requiring full backports, then remove spark/v3.4 immediately afterwards and mark it end-of-life.
Formalize the same deprecate, release, remove sequence in the multi-engine support doc for Spark and Flink versions.
Spark 3.4 is not fully end-of-life yet because it stays on the 1.11.x branch, which may see more releases.

outcome.note: Spark 3.4 was marked Deprecated in the docs (PR #14099) and the removal PR (#14122) was merged in May 2026; 1.11.0 is the last Iceberg version with Spark 3.4 support.

why_it_matters: Changes on main no longer need a Spark 3.4 backport, and users on Spark 3.4 must stay on the Iceberg 1.11 line.
